target: direction at the next scheduled Bank of Canada policy announcement
deadline: 16:00 America/Toronto on the preceding Canadian banking business day
model: StandardScaler followed by multinomial logistic regression
historical_test_status: release-date-aware reconstruction using current numerical vintages; not an untouched prospective test
same_day_macro_releases: excluded because the source calendar has day precision
text_features: not used; no verified publication-time corpus
market_benchmark: not available; no meeting-specific timestamped OIS feed
model_selection: fixed specification; do not tune on these evaluation outcomes
